pcs.pc_description: identify the operational structure of different front office functions, like reception, reservation, guest services, accounts, communication, etc.
interact with the supervisor/manager to understand service requirements and clarify doubts
report for duty on time
wear proper uniform as per the organizational policies
check occupancy forecast, expected arrivals and, departures, guest confirmation, VIP in-house, special movements or events etc.
review the room assignment/allocation status, especially for VIPs, etc.
print Registration Card (for pre- registered guests)
prepare amenity vouchers
check that all special guest requests are taken care of
ensure all travel arrangements like pick-up, if any, are taken care of
arrange for special welcome arrangements as required
ensure all VIP/ group arrival requirements are arranged for accordingly
greet and welcome the guest as per organizational policy
enquire the name of the guest to search for the reservation record
collect mandatory information from the guests
cross-check the identity document details of the guests against original
fill guest registration record, manually or in the property management system, and attach the counter signed true copies of valid ID documents
collect advance money from the guests if the reservation is not pre-paid
prepare advance receipt for advance payment
present the receipt to the guests as per organizational standards
update advance payment details in the PMS

modules.module_title: Check reservation details and allot room to guest

pcs.pc_description: cross-check the reservation details with the guest
check for details such as room type, meal plan, number of people, etc. and confirm the guest’s room preference (e.g. pool view, suite, non-smoking, etc.)
check for availability of room as per guest’s preference
inform walk-in guests about any non- availability of room and inform the next available date/time
inform guests of reservation of any non- availability of preferred room and provide alternate options
allot the room if it is already blocked for the guest as per reservation status/instructions or allot a VR (Vacant Ready) room
handle any special request from guest, e.g. wheelchair etc.
negotiate with the guest requesting ad hoc discounts, as per organizational guidelines
offer discount based on the seasonal occupancy and within the organization’s stipulated limit
reconfirm the type of room, tariff, and other agreed details to the guest before allotting the room
allot adjacent rooms, if available to the guests travelling in a group/families
ensure collection of advance money from the guests if the reservation is not pre-paid
reconfirm mode of payment from guest (e.g. credit/debit card, cash, travel voucher, forex card, etc.)
upsell and cross- sell services to maximize revenue for the organization
update reservation status to check-in and link to guest history, manually or in the Property Management System (PMS)
ensure guest's satisfaction with room allocation as per their preference
handover room keys to bell attendant to escort guest to room

modules.module_title: Respond to guest queries and requests

pcs.pc_description: respond to guest queries/request on reservation/rooms/facilities, etc.
assist guests with requests/information on transportation, restaurants in the city, shopping areas, etc.
respond to clarification request on operating procedure of any equipment/controls inside the guest room
change the guest’s room as per their preference or request, if possible
coordinate with bell desk to carry out room change procedure and luggage movement in presence of guest

modules.module_title: Receive and deliver mails/messages/package to guest

pcs.pc_description: screen packages/parcels for security check
deliver any received message/mail/package to the correct guest room on time
enter messages/mail/facsimiles/parcel/package details in the logbook with guest name, room number and staff responsible for delivery
keep the deliverables safely at the front office/bell desk, if the guest is not in the room or, if the guest is not in-house but is due for arrival and set an alert on the PMS
inform guest if there are any visitors

pcs.pc_description: respond to guest inquiries as per SOP
provide the details and availability of various rooms and respective facilities to the guest based on guest preference and availability
inform guests about various plans, packages, and seasonal rates during their request for booking as per the reservation policy of the hotel and the reservations agreement guidelines
obtain necessary details from guests to process the reservation
maintain reservation record of the guests
inform concerned departments like housekeeping, travel, etc. about changes in the guest reservations to arrange the requirements accordingly
make changes in guest reservation if requested by the guest like modifying reservation dates, altering type of room reserved, upgrading/ downgrading room reservations in case of room unavailability
inform the guest about the cancellation policy and provide reservation cancellations services on guest’s request
inform the guests about the modification/reservation cancellation made
process refund payments to guests in the event of cancellation
